title: Word Squares II
summary: Given a list of distinct 4-letter words, find all possible word squares that can be formed.
statement: Given a list of distinct 4-letter words, find all possible word squares that can be formed. Each word square must have matching characters at the specified positions: the first and last characters of the top and bottom words must match, and the first and last characters of the left and right words must match. Return the word squares in lexicographic order.
constraints: words contains 4 to 15 distinct lowercase strings of length four.
Choose four distinct words as top, left, right, and bottom.
All four corner characters must agree and results are lexicographically sorted.
hints: Only the four corner characters constrain the square.
Choose top and left sharing their first character, then right beginning with top’s last character.
Choose a distinct bottom whose first and last characters match the lower ends of left and right, then sort results.
The nested choices enumerate every ordered role assignment exactly once, and the four tests are precisely the definition.
editorial: The nested choices enumerate every ordered role assignment exactly once, and the four tests are precisely the definition.

tests.explanation: The two valid ordered quadruples satisfy all four corner equalities.
No four distinct words satisfy every required corner.
